Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.models

Class Cat

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.models.Cat
public final class Cat extends Object
Represents the player's virtual cat, holding its current stats, level, and inventory.
